statement: For every L>0, inf_{eta_1,eta_2>0} R_2^L(eta_1,eta_2) = 1/(5+4*sqrt(2)+sqrt(9+8*sqrt(2))), with attainment by the ordered normalized schedule (L eta_1,L eta_2)=(sqrt(2),(3+sqrt(9+8*sqrt(2)))/4). No uniqueness is asserted.
contribution: A complete exact proof: four explicit one-dimensional smooth-convex witnesses yield lower bounds whose strict sublevel sets admit an elementary exact partition of the entire positive ordered step quadrant, while six nonnegative directed-interpolation multipliers with a rank-one PSD residual give a dimension-free matching upper certificate at the stated radical schedule.
